_help: Every photo and video spot on the site. Each one now holds a brand graphic or the animated 60-second intro (made in v1.14 from the site's own copy and published case-study figures). To use your own photo or video instead, upload it to assets/media, put its path in "src" (for example "assets/media/workshop.jpg") and describe it in "alt". Videos: MP4, with an optional poster image and captions file (.vtt). A spot used on several pages fills them all. "label" says what a real photo there should show.

intro-video.used_on: Home, and the top of Work with me (it replaces your portrait there once added)
